lines.text: This shrimp is only as long as your hand, and it punches at eighty kilometers an hour. Underwater!
Water is thick, so a normal punch crawls. But its club speeds up like a bullet.
It's called the mantis shrimp, and its punch hits with about fifteen hundred newtons.
That is enough to smash a snail shell, or crack a crab like a nut.
But here is the twist. The club moves so fast that the water can't keep up,
so it tears into tiny bubbles. And those bubbles collapse in a snap,
hitting the prey a second time!
One swing, two hits. Now imagine what that shrimp does when it's angry!
